# theme

Muster theme preference and the Claude theme family poll.

Read first: `docs/features/theme/spec.md`, `docs/features/theme/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred` — The issue dialog ships its disabled primary button with no distinct visual state, like every other button; an app-wide disabled sweep is a backlog item. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: issue, theme) → `docs/adr/issue-disabled-button-affordance-deferred.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-system-font-stacks-only` — Typography uses system font stacks only; no web fonts, no CDN, no vendored font binaries. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/stack-system-font-stacks-only.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose` — The daemon-down banner uses dedicated banner tokens; the rose token stays reserved for the Failed state. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: theme, connection) → `docs/adr/theme-banner-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose` — Destructive actions use a danger token family; rose stays reserved for the Failed state rather than the rule being amended. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: theme, actions) → `docs/adr/theme-danger-tokens-not-rose.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction` — Visual direction A, instrument: dark, dense, mono metadata, session state as a coloured rail stripe; the design system is the review checklist. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: theme) → `docs/adr/theme-instrument-visual-direction.md`
- `kb:fact/theme-config-key-and-enum` — Claude Code's theme is the global-config key theme with a six-value enum; family is startsWith("light"); default dark. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.258..2.1.267; features: theme) → `docs/facts/theme-config-key-and-enum.md`
